query: UPDATE outbox SET subscriber_mask=subscriber_mask|$3::smallint,attempts=CASE WHEN (subscriber_mask|$3::smallint)=15 THEN 0 ELSE attempts END,delivered_at=CASE WHEN (subscriber_mask|$3::smallint)=15 THEN now() ELSE delivered_at END,dead_letter_at=CASE WHEN (subscriber_mask|$3::smallint)=15 THEN NULL ELSE dead_letter_at END,error_code=CASE WHEN (subscriber_mask|$3::smallint)=15 THEN NULL ELSE error_code END WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$2
